header: Problem 6 Preparation of TPP. TPP is 5,10,15,20-tetraphenylporphyrin (M = 614.7 g·mol-1) and can be prepared rapidly in quantity by the following method: 'O=CC1=CC=CC=C1' + 'C1=CNC=C1' --('CCC(=O)O', reflux, 30 min)--> 'C1(/C=CC(/C(C2=CC=CC=C2)=C(N/3)/C=CC3=C(C(C=C/4)=NC4=C5\C6=CC=CC=C6)/C7=CC=CC=C7)=N1)=C(C8=CC=CC=C8)\C9=CC=C5N9'.

Propionic acid is drawn above a right-pointing reaction arrow, and "reflux, 30 min" is written below it. The product on the right is 'C1(/C=CC(/C(C2=CC=CC=C2)=C(N/3)/C=CC3=C(C(C=C/4)=NC4=C5\C6=CC=CC=C6)/C7=CC=CC=C7)=N1)=C(C8=CC=CC=C8)\C9=CC=C5N9'.

subquestions.text_open: 6-1 Pretreatment of reagents: the benzaldehyde and pyrrole used in the reaction must be dried and purified. 6-1-1 Select the drying agents suitable for pyrrole. (a) P_4O_10    (b) anhydrous Na_2SO_4    (c) concentrated H_2SO_4    (d) CaH_2
rubric: (b), (d). (1 point each, 2 points total; any incorrect selection receives no credit.)
